text: Read WORKSPACE.md in this directory and follow it. Implement Phase 3 per inputs/ (start with inputs/prompts/stage3.md, inputs/TASK.md, and the assigned specs) inside candidate/ only, building on the existing Phase 1-2 artifact without regressing it. Keep evidence honest per the honesty contract and update IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json and evidence/ as the task requires. Before finishing, run all four package gates in candidate/ (pnpm test, pnpm typecheck, pnpm lint, pnpm build) and fix failures. Do not seal or score anything. When done, report a short summary and the gate results, then stop.
Briefly inform the user about the task result and perform any follow-up actions (if needed).
Phase 3 gates look done. Reply with any usage you can report for this phase: input tokens, output tokens, reasoning tokens, tool calls, cost USD. If you cannot measure them, say so. Do not seal.
